name: Negative Energy Flood

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

components.m: a broken bone and a square of black silk

summary: Reference-only: A visible non-Undead creature saves Constitution against 3d10 + 25 Necrotic, half on success. A Humanoid killed rises at your next turn start as a Zombie obeying verbal orders for 24 hours, then acting independently. An Undead target instead gains 3d10 Temporary HP. Damage gains 1d10 per slot above 5.
